en: PRESS STUDY TOUR TO ANDAMAN & NICOBAR ISLAND A twelve-member Press Study Tour team to Andaman & Nicobar Island, led by Pi Lallianpuii, Director, Information & Public Relations department departed Aizawl today. The team members include 3 officials from I&PR department and 9 members of Mizoram Journalist Association. The Information & Public Relations Department-sponsored Press Study Tour will take place from 9th December, 2019 to 15th December, 2019 during which they will visit and study various developmental works undertaken by the government of Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Andaman & Nicobar Island a Press Study Tour neiturte hian sawrkar hmalakna hrang hrang an zirchian bakah sawrkar hotuliante an kawm dawn a ni. Press Study Tour hi December ni 9, 2019 atanga December ni 15, 2019 thleng neih tur a ni a. en: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. The State is also committed to take up more rural development projects in the coming Financial Year.

en: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: MAMIT-AH UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA-IN MEETING NEIHPUI 882/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022 : Shri Parshottam Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Govt' of India chuan vawiin khan DC Conference Hall, Mamit-ah Mamit khawpui chhunga Sorkar Officials te leh Central Schemes hrang hranga beneficiaries te kawmna a nei. Vawiin thutkhawm Pu Lalnunhlua, District Bawrhsap kaihhruaiah hian Aspirational District Programme hnuaia hmalakna hrang hrangte Pu Lalsanglura, Aspirational District Programme Nodal Officer chuan Power point presentation hmangin chipchiar takin a tarlang a. Hmasawnna awmte leh hmachhawp/tanlakna tur hrang hrangte sawiho zui nghal a ni. Shri Parshottam Rupala, Union Minister chuan Mamit District a rawn tlawh chhan leh inkawmhona neih anih chhan sawiin Central Schemes hrang hrang District mipuite'n an hlawhtlinpui theih nan leh tha taka kalpui anih leh nih loh thlithlai a, harsatna awm angte hrechianga sutkianpui tura lokal anih thu a sawi a. District Concern Officers te pawhin Sorkar hmalakna Programme hrang hrang zirchiang a, beneficiaries te'n an hlawhtlinpui ngei theih nana tan la turin a fuih. Mamit District chu Aspirational District anih angin natna khirhkhan bik inenkawlna atan cheng Nuai 5 thleng bill theih turin ruahmanna Central-in a siam a, Mamit District chhungah mi sing 5 thlanchhuah atanga sing 3 te chu dawng tura thlanchhuah an nih tawh thu sawiin, a bak sing 2 pawh hian an hmuh theih nan hmalakpui mek an nih thu a sawi bawk. PM-Kisan chu Aadhaar Card, ram leh Bank Account nei tan dil theih anih thu sawiin, a concern department te pawhin Mamit District chhunga kuthnathawktute'n he scheme atanga hlawkna mi tam thei ang berin an dawn theih nana tan la turin a chah bawk. Union Minister hian vawiin inkawmhona-a Sorkar Officials leh Beneficiaries te'n an harsatna leh mamawh an lo thlente chu a theih ang anga bawhzuisak a tum thu a sawi a ni. He hunah hian Central Schemes hrang hrang AYUSHMAN BHARAT - Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat - Jan Arogya Yojana, e-Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi (PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission (individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY leh PM-Kisan hnuaia Beneficiaries te leh a changtu Officials te kawmna neiin zawhna leh chhanna hun hman zui a ni bawk. en: DEO LAWNGTLAI PUBLISHES DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS published a draft electoral roll 2020 of three assembly constituencies within Lawngtlai District tomorow at her office chamber and handed over the draft electoral rolls to representatives of the political parties. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. mz: LAWNGTLAIAH DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 TLANGZARH A NI Kum 2020 atana Lawngtlai District-a Assembly bial pathuma draft electoral roll chu Nimin (16.12.2019) khan Lawngtlai District Election Officer, Lawngtlai Bawrhsap ni bawk Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan a office chamber-ah a tlangzarh a. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. Draft electoral roll tlangzarh tak atanga a lan danin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520, an vaiin mi 31372 an awm a; 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402, an vaiin mi 26926 an awm a; 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C bialah voter mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374, an vaiin mi 24000 an awm a; assembly bial pathumah hian vote nei mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296, an vaiin mi 82298 an awm a ni. Summary revision neih turah hian sawi duh neite tan kum thar January ni 15 thleng hun hawn a ni a. February ni 7, 2020-ah final electoral roll chu tar chhuah tura tih a ni. Hemi rual hian Tuichawng biala polling station 62 awm saah a thar 8 hawn belh niin, polling station 70 a awm tawh dawn a; Lawngtlai West-a polling station awm sa 68-ah a thar 1 hawn belh niin, polling station 69 a awm tawh ang a; Lawngtlai East-a polling station awm sa 35 baka a thar hawn belh 7 nen polling station 42 awm tawhin, Lawngtlai District chhunga bial pathumah hian a vaiin polling station 181 a awm tawh dawn a ni. en: CHILDREN'S WEEK IN MAMIT DISTRICT Under the theme of 'Happy Childhood', Children's Week was inaugurated yesterday at GSA Playground Mamit organised by District Child Protection Unit Mamit District as a Fun Day initiative Programme for the Children. Pu Shashank Jaiswal, IPS, SP Mamit who inaugurated the Children's Week express his gratitute for the organiser of the Programme and praised the wisdom underlying in organising Fun Day Programme to all playful Children in the District. He also mention that District Executive Force is always ready to help the Children who needs the help of proper and cordial policing. Dr. R. Lalrinhlua, DCPO Mamit talked about the reasons behind organising this Fun Day and marked the importance of creating playful and creative environment so that the children can blossom in the avatarhood they are born with. He also mentioned the need for proper guidance of these children in the right path who shall be leaders of tommorrow. The Fun Day was hosted by Pi Vanlalruati, PO (IC) DCPU Mamit in which many playful games and items were made present for the children such as Bouncy Trampoline, See Saw, Mega Block, Ball Pool, Spin the Wheel, Ball Kick, Dart Game, Cup Game, Ball Score, Photo Booth, Talent Hunt and Bow and Arrow Games. en: MIZORAM RAJYA SABHA M.P CALLS FOR CENTRAL GOVERNMENTâ€™S INTERVENTION FOR RESTORATION OF PEACE IN MYANMAR. No.612/2020-2021 Aizawl, 15th March,2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha M.P K.Vanlalvena called on Shri Venkaiah Naidu, Chairman, Rajya Sabha and Vice President of India today at his official residence and calls for the central governmentâ€™s intervention for restoration of peace in the trouble torn Myanmar, and to provide relief measures for Myanmar nationals who crossed international border to take shelter in Mizoram following gross atrocities committed against protesters who stand up for democracy, human rights and justice since the military junta took control of the Myanmar government. During his meeting with the Vice President, Vanlalvena was accompanied by MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala. Both raised their concern that situation in Myanmar could go from bad to worse. While many protesters have lost their lives and many more suffer injuries, a large number of protesters are arbitrarily arrested and detained. In view of the grim situation, Vanlalvena urged the central government to stand up for the people of Myanmar and review its foreign policy towards Myanmar and try to find solution for the restoration of peace and harmony in the country. While raising internatioanl issues, Vanlalvena also asked the Vice Prsident to take necessary measures for induction of a member from Mizo community in the Union Public Service Commission and to create a separate cadre for Mizoram in All India Civl Service saying, 35 years since statehood is a period long enough for Mizoram to share the AGMUT cadre. He also raised the need to open an examination centre in Aizawl for Staff Selection Commission. Attachment Loading attachment...

Pu Vena hi MNF Adviser Pu Rosangzuala'n a tawiawm a. Myanmar ram buaina avanga sipai kut tuara thi leh hliam tam tak an awm tawh thu leh, mi tam tak jaila khung an nih mek thute, he buaina avanga thi leh hliam zat dik tak hriat theih a nih loh thu leh an la pun belh zel dawn nia a lan thute Vice President hi hrilhin Myanmar sipai leh police te zinga mi eng emaw zat chuan Myanmar mipuite chunga kutthlak an duh loh avangin an ralthuamte surrender in civilian midang eng emaw zat te nen inhumhimna zawngin Mizoramah an rawn tlan lut tawh a ni tih an hrilh a. Heng Myanmar atanga raltlan lo lutte chhawmdawlna tur ngaihtuah a tul thu pawh thlenin Myanmar mipuite chunga tawrhna titawp tura a tul dan anga hma la turin India Vice President chu an ngen a. Myanmar laka sawrkar laipui policy chu ennawn tula an hriat thu an thlen bawk a ni. Pu Vena leh Pu Rosangzuala te chuan India independent hnuah Union Public Service Commission member ah Mizoram mi pakhat mah an la awm ngai loh avangin UPSC ah Mizo dah ve tura hma lak pui turin Vice President chu an ngen a. State puitling nih hnu kim 35 ah pawh Mizoram chu All India Civil Service ah AGMUT cadre hnuaia a la awm chu a hun tawh lovin Mizoram Cadre hran siam a hun tawh tih Vice President hnenah hian an thlen a. Staff Selection Commission hnuaia hna dil tu ten Guwahati ah kher exam ngai tawh lova Aizawla exam centre dah a nih theihna tur pawh ngaihtuah pui turin Vice President Pu M.Venkaiah Naidu chu an ngen a ni. en: LUNGLEI DISTRICT - COVID-19 NO TOLERANCE FORTNIGHT No.318/2020-2021 â€˜COVID - 19 No Tolerance Fortnightâ€™ (26 th October to 9 th November 2020) - A Zero Tolerance Drive with an objective to break the chain of infection through strict observance of SOPS and Guidelines, commenced yesterday at Lunglei District along with the rest of the State. â€˜COVID - 19 No Tolerance Fortnightâ€™ Banners have been put up in prominent locations along the main spine of the District capital, Lunglei town. Each locality within the District have been requested to announce Covid appropriate behavior through Public Announcement System (Tlangau) at least thrice a day. Covid-19 Executive Teams, comprising 30% of Government employees in the District have also been set up as per guidelines laid down by the DM&R Department, Government of Mizoram. 24 Covid-19 Executive Teams led by their respective Team Leaders and in partnership with Local Task Forces are on duty across the District, enforcing strict imposition of penalties as stipulated under Section 5 of the Mizoram (Containment and Prevention of the Spread of COVID- 19) Act, 2020. Eight Executive Magistrates/Incident Commanders have also been appointed to lead these Executive Teams. Government employees in Lunglei District have also joined the nationwide â€˜Jan Andolan for COVID-19 Appropriate Behaviourâ€™ launched by the Prime Minister on 8 th October, 2020 by taking part in the online pledge taking. Government Departments have also taken initiatives to put up Covid Educational Posters in their office premises. Lunglei District has so far recorded 278 Covid-19 cases with 267 patients already discharged from Covid Care Centres and 11 Active cases at present. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. mz: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY HOVIN INTEGRITY PLEDGE THUTIAM CHHAM RUAL 2547/2023-2024 Vawiin ni 30th October atanga 5th November, 2023 chhungin India rampumah Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 hman a ni dawn a. Kumin Vigilance Week thupui chu - 'Hlemhletna hnawl la, ram tan thawk rawh' (Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation) a ni. Ram hmundangte rualin vawiin chawhma khan Mizoramah pawh 'Vigilance Week 2023' hawn nan Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma kaihhruaina hnuaiah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a sorkar hnathawk, officials and staff zawng zawngten a huhovin 'Integrity Pledge' thuchham an chham rual a. Sorkar office tina Heads of Office-te pawhin an hnuaia thawk officer leh staff-te nen anmahni office hmun theuhah 'Integrity Pledge' hi an chhamrual bawk a ni. He Integrity Pledge hmang hian sorkar hnathawk tupawhin hlemhletna a do tlat tur thu te, sorkar dan leh thupek anga dik leh felfai taka hnathawh a tum tur thu te, mipui rawngbawlna a ni tih hriain a nungchang leh hnathawh danah te mawihnai tak leh midangte entawn tlaka awm turin leh hlemhletna thil a hmuh emaw hriat te chu ngawih bosan mai lova, sorkarah report ngei turin thuchham an chham a ni. en: DECLAMATION CONTEST ON MY BHARAT-VIKSIT BHARAT, 2047 HELD IN LUNGLEI. 329/2023-2024 LUNGLEI; the 12th, January, 2024: National Youth Day-2024 celebration was held at Art & Culture Auditorium here in Venglai Lunglei, and the function was organized by Nehru Yuva Kendra in collaboration with YMA Sub Hqrs,Lunglei. To commemorate this auspicious day; a Declamation contest on My Bharat-Viksit Bharat@2047 was conducted for the youths of age between 15 to 29. National Youth Day- 2024 celebration function was presided over by Shri CMS Dawngliana Vice President, YMA Sub Hqrs,Lunglei and Shri Lalzuithanga Khiangte, Chairman,Lunglei Municipal Council graced the function as Chief Guest. Speaking on the occasion Shri Lalzuithanga Khiangte spoke at length the huge contribution made by Swami Vivekananda towards society in regard to reformation and upliftment of downtroddens;and exhorted the youths to emulate and follow the footsteps of the pious and sagacious Swami Vivekananda in every possible way. He also passionately reasoned the youths that it was a high time that they buckle up their belts and tighten up their shoe laces to embark upon the future- long road ahead with gusto, and saying a â€˜Big Noâ€™ to all the social vices on their way, for the good of society and for themselves. Shri Lalrinchhana, NYK Lunglei informed the gathering audiences; the purpose of observance of National Youth Day/ National Youth Week and added that 12th January is the birth day of Swami Vivekananda and Government of India decided to observe this day as National Youth Day since 1984, and henceforth 13 th -19 th January was observed as the National Youth Week; and during this week various events and functions were held to inform and motivate the youths across India by imparting the teaching of Swami Vivekananda. Shri Lalthabuanga, officer i/c Traffic delivered lectures on â€œRoad safetyâ€ on this occasion. Attachment Loading attachment...

He hunah hian Pu Lalzuithanga Khiangte, Chairman,LMC chuan khuallian niin a hmanpui. National Youth Day 2024 hmanna inhkawm Pu CMS Dawngliana Vice President, YMA Sub Hqrs,Lunglei kaihhruaiah khuallian Pu Lalzuithanga Khiangte chuan Swami Vivekananda in thalai te tan a inhmang mi a ni a, hnam hnuaihnung zawk te chawikan duh leh child marriage duh lo tu a ni a. en: HEALTH MINISTER INAUGURATES 43RD ANNUAL CONFERENCE OF IMA, MIZORAM STATE BRANCH The Indian Medical Association (IMA), Mizoram State Branch observed its 43rd annual conference today at Aijal Club where the Minister for Health and Family Welfare Department Dr.R.Lalthangliana was the Chief Guest. The theme of this yearâ€™s conference is â€œEnding the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Communityâ€. Speaking at the inaugural function, the Minister said that the government is committed to advance public health efforts and improve health for all. He encouraged the medical community to revive their efforts and recommit themselves in serving the public. Established in 1976, the Mizoram State Branch of IMA currently has 750 members out of which 33 are newly inducted. The Mizoram State Branch received two prestigious awards this year, namely the IMA Special Award for Organizing (IMA North East Leaders Meet Conclave) and President Appreciation Award (for IMA Membership Drive Trophy) from the IMA General Headquarters. The IMA is a voluntary organization where all doctors, whether employed by the government or practising in private, are registered members. The organization looks after the interest of doctors as well as the well being of the community at large. It aims to promote medical and its allied sciences, improve public health and maintain honour and dignity of the medical profession.

en: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: MYC CHAIRMAN IN SERKAWN LUNGLEIAH MYC INCUBATION CENTRE TUR LUNGPHUM A PHUM No.4413/2021-2022 Aizawl, 26 th March 2022 : Vawiin khan Lunglei North bialtu MLA, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia chuan Serkawn, Lungleiah Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre tur lungphum a phum. MYC Incubation Centre hmun tur hi Lena Stadium bulah awmin a ram hi Serkawn VC te pek a ni. He hunah hian Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Serkawn khawtlang hruaitute leh tlawmngai pawl hrang hrang aiawhte an tel a ni. Mizoram Youth Commission Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia chuan MYC Incubation Centre-ah hian thalaite hmasawnna tura hmalakna hrang hrang â€“ competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development leh entrepreneurship-te a len vek tur thu sawiin residential tura ruahman a nih thu a sawi a. Thalaite hmakhua ngaia an ram phal taka pe tu Serkawn khawtlang te chungah lawmthu sawiin an ram pek chu kan human resource tih hmasawnna kawngah leh kan ram economy than len zelna kawngah tangkai taka hman anih tur thu a sawi. A sawi zel naah MYC Chairman chuan Mizo thalaite hmasawnna turin MYC chuan theihtawp a chhuah zel dawn a ni tiin Lunglei, Siaha leh Kolasib District -ah te MYC Coaching Centre hawn tawh niin Champhai ah pawh hawn leh thuai tum a ni a. Aizawl leh Serchhip ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek niin, Lunglei ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek pawh zawhfel tep a nih thu a sawi. Mizo thalaite hawizau zela, National level chona va man phak ve tura kawng kawhhmuh zel MYC chuan a tum thu sawiin competitive exam coaching mai bakah cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training, music leh sports lamah te hmalakna kal mekin heng hmalaknte hi zau zawka kalpui zel tum anih thu a sawi. Kum 2020 atanga kalpui MYC Super IAS 20 chungchang pawh sawilangin MYC Chairman chuan heng zirlai thlanchhuah 20 te hi MYC sponsor in Delhi ah thla thum (February â€“ March 2021) coaching zuk kalin MYC nena agreement an neih ang ngei in UPSC Preliminary Exam 2021 chu an zavaiin an ziak veka. Agreement-ah hian MYC Super IAS 20 te hian UPSC 2021 an tlin loh chuan kum thum dang (2022-2024) preliminary exam an bei leh tura tih niin hemi karah hian state level competitive exam emaw exam dang an ziah phalsak an ni a. Heng exam te an ziah avang hian kan agreement an bawhchhe lo a ni, a ti a. Super IAS hi zau zawka kalpui tum niin Super IAS 40 kalpui turin budget ah cheng vaibelchhe 2 dah fel tawh a nih thu sawiin chhimlam District zirlaite lo ngaihven ve ngei turin a chah a ni. Hemi bakah hian Khawiva panna kawng, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei kawng leh Lunglei khawpui chhung kawng te siam that tur anih thu sawiin MZU Southern Campus tura ruahman chei that hna pawh tluang taka kalin a budget hi cheng vaibelchhe 15 ah tihpun anih thu a sawi bawk. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng pawhin thu sawiin MYC hnuaiah thawktu staff tlemte chauh awm mahse Mizo thalaite tana an hmalakna hi a hlu in a chhuanawm takzet a ni, a ti a. Lunglei khawpui ah zirna in changtlung tak Incubation Centre kan nei tur chu kan vannei takzet a, mipuiten kan hlut a kan hman tangkai thiam a tul dawn a ni tiin Lunglei District thalaite chu tun aia hawizau tur leh tih tak takna nena hma la turin a sawm a ni. Vawiin program-ah hian Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn te pawhin thu sawiin Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei in lawmthu sawina hun a hmang a ni. en: GOVT. ITI, AIZAWL CONVOCATION DAY 176/2022-2023 Aizawl the 19th September, 2022 : For the first time in its history, Govt. Industrial Training Institute of Aizawl, Mizoram organized a Convocation programme on 17th September, 2022 for 143 students who have completed their various courses. In the academic session of 2022-2023, Govt. ITI College enrolled 384 students and the Institute registered an overall passed percentage of 97.14% which is the Instituteâ€™s best record since its inception. With this record the Institute ranked at sixth place in the country. At this Convocation programme Certificates were handed out to the 143 students who have successfully completed their courses. The Convocation programme started with a welcome address by Mr. K. Lalhmingliana, Director, LESDE department who felicitated the students on their accomplishments. Honâ€™ble Chief Guest Mr. Lalramsanga Sailo, Secretary, LESDE Department lauded Govt. ITI Aizawl for having one of the best results among hundreds of ITIâ€™s in the country. He highlighted the importance of upgrading ITIâ€™s in Mizoram towards development of skill and for self â€“employment of the youth of Mizoram. He also mentioned that many of the local technicians in Mizoram are former students of ITIâ€™s and among the recently graduated students of Motor Mechanic Vehicle (MMV), 14 of them have secured a letter of appointment from major companies even before announcement of their final results. This is the first time that the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE) has organized a Convocation programme for the entire country and further planned to celebrate it every year. The main programme was held at New Delhi in commemoration on the day of Vishwakarman Diwas(Day) with our honâ€™ble Prime Minister virtually addressing the Convocation. The Convocation function closed with the Chief Guest handing out a small award to the Top-3 meritorious students in various discipline. First - Lalpekthara, Electronics Mechanic Second - F Lalrammawia, Baker & Confectionery, Hmangaihsangzuali, Stenography Third - LalawmpuiaSailo, Stenography, Lalthlamuani, Baker & Confectionery The programme was attended by the students and Instructor of Industrial Training Institute along with noteworthy alumni and representatives from the industry sector. en: FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS FOR BY-ELECTION TO TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY PUBLISHED District Election Officer & Deputy Commissioner of Siaha District, Shri.Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS published and handed over Final E/Rolls for By-Election to Tokalo MDC Constituency, to the representatives of various Political Parties in Hard & Soft copy, at his office chamber, here at Siaha tomorrow. Basing 1st January, 2019 as qualifying date, a Summary Revision of E/Rolls had been be carried out smoothly as per the Schedule prescribed by SEC. Final E/Rolls Publication event was attended by: Shri.K.Vanlalthiana,Addl.DC, Shri. Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer, Shri. N.Vabeiratlua, DIPRO,Representatives of MTP(H), MCHP(H) and various Political Parties. A just published Final E/Rolls consisted of 450 female voters and 505 male voters, totalling to 955 voters in all. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: SPORTS MINISTER LAUDS MIZORAM GIRLSâ€™ VICTORY IN NES U-19 FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles today organised a felicitation programme at Loch Hall within the precincts of 46 Assam Rifles, Aizawl for team members of the Mizoram U-19 Girls Team who recently lifted the Assam Rifles organized North East States Under-19 Championship held during July 17-21 at Diphu and Kohima. Sports Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte presided over the function and lauded the efforts of the team members and the support provided by the Assam Rifles. Speaking on the occasion, the Minister highlighted the role football has played in connecting the North Eastern states with the rest of the country and said that it is an important tool in strengthening national integration and in helping the region mainstream with the rest of the country. Appreciating the cooperation between the Mizoram Government and Mizoram Football Association (MFA) in furthering the cause of football, the Minister expressed hope that this partnership will grow stronger and reach new heights in the coming days. He said that the Government will support MFA and other sports organizations and associations in all the possible way whether through financial assistance or otherwise. He pointed that for the first time ever Mizoram will soon have a comprehensive sports policy â€˜Mizoram Sports Policyâ€™ and through this policy Mizoram will achieve accolades in sports, he added. The Minister also spelt out new initiatives in the pipeline for development of football in the state and said that Flood Lighting and other works of Rajiv Gandhi Stadium to meet international standards will soon be completed. MFA President Shri Lal Thanzara and other office bearers of MFA were also present on the occasion. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: SPORTS MINISTER HOVIN NES U-19 TEAM TE CHAWIMAWI Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles bultumin vawiin khan Loch Hall, 46 Assam Rifles hmunpui ah tun hnaia neih NES Under-19 Women Football Championship a champion Mizoram Team te chawimawi hun â€˜Felicitation Programmeâ€™ buatsaih a ni a. He hun hi Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royteâ€™n a hmanpui a. Mizoram Football Association (MFA) hruaitute pawh he hunah hian an tel bawk a ni. Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royte chuan Mizoram Hmeichhe U-19 Team in NES U-19 Championship a, champion an ni chu a lawmpuiin thu sawiin he hnehna hi Sawrkar ta emaw, a buatsaihtu leh buaipuitu Assam Rifles ta emaw, MFA ta emaw a ni lova, Mizoram mipui zawng zawng ta a ni tiin team te chu Mizoram mipui chhuanvawr an nih thu a sawi. Mizoram Hmeichhe team in Nagaland Hmeichhe team, India aiawh tunhnaia international level a tel te, an hneh hian kan hmeichhe footballer te an that zia a tih lan thu a sawi lang a. MFA in football thanna atan an hmalakna te chu Sawrkar ang pawhin a thei ang angin belhchaha, tiphuia , tichak turin Sawrkar in hma a lak zel tur thu a sawi a, Sawrkar leh MFA thawhona tha tak chu chhunzawm zela, tichak turin MFA hruaitute a sawm bawk a ni. Pu Robert Romawia Royte chuan football chu hnam impumkhatna leh a tihchakna hmanraw tha tak anih dan sawiin football avangin Hmarchhak state leh India hmun dangte kan in pawh tha leh zual a, inuanau boruak tha zawk siamin hnam inpumkhatna a tichak a, football thil tih theihna hi a ropui a, ngaihnep theih a ni lo tih a sawi. Sawrkar chuan football rualin sports discipline dangte tun aia nasa leh zawka hmasawn tir a duh avangin Mizoram in ala neih ngai lo Mizoram Sports Policy chu buaipui mek a nih tih sawiin taekwondo, basketball, volleyball leh sports discipline te than dan chu a lawmawm a, sports association te tichak turin Sawrkarin ngaihtuahna a sen mek a, inrelbawlna tha zawka kan neih thei nan Sports Minister a nih ang pawhin theihtawp a chhuah tur thu a sawilang a. International level match thleng thei turin Rajiv Gandhi Sports Stadium ah Flood Lighting tha tak a awm thei an hma lak mek a nih thu te, Aizawl khawpuia football field dang 4/5 vel siamna tur hmun dap mek a nih thu te, Zembawk field atan grass phahna tur sanction a awm tawh thu te leh Khawzawl field ah pawh grass phah turin ruahmanna siam mek a nih thu te a sawi lang bawk a ni. Sports Minister chuan Assam Rifles in Football leh Mizo thalaite hmasawnna atana an inpekna chu fawkawm tiin he thawhona tha hi chhunzawm zela, Mizoram thalaite hmasawnna leh an talen te phochhuahna kawnga theihtawp chhuahpui zel turin a sawm bawk a ni. He hunah hian HQ 23 Sector Assam Rifles hotupa, Brig. Vinod S. Leh MFA President Pu Lal Thanzara te pawhin thusawiin infiamite an fuih a ni. U-19 Team a tel zawngte hi Assam Rifles hian thilpek an hlan bawk a ni. North East States U-19 Girls Football Championship hi Directorate General Assam Rifles (DGAR) chuan Diphu leh Kohima ah te July ni 17 leh July ni 21 inkar khan a buatsaih a, he Championship Mizoram team an champion a ni. Later in the evening, he will co-chair the meeting of G-20 Core Team with Smt Renu Sharma, Chief Secretary and attend Cultural Evening-cum-dinner to be hosted by Tourism Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte. Shri Harsh Vardhan Shringla will leave Aizawl tomorrow via Lengpui Airport after calling on the stateâ€™s Chief Minister Shri Zoramthanga. Attachment Loading attachment...

Pu Harsh Vardhan Shringla hian Lengpui tumhmuna inbuatsaihna kal mek te chu enfiah nghalin, Business-20 meeting neihna tur Mizoram University Auditorium leh Multipurpose Hall-te a enfiah nghal bawk ang. en: FELICITATION PROGRAM HELD FOR LUNGLEI EAST A/C MEDALISTS - MIZORAM STATE GAMES 2019 A felicitation program was held yesterday at the Lunglei BDO Conference Hall to honour medalists who represented the Lunglei East Assembly Constituency at the Mizoram State Games 2019 held on the 2 nd week of December last year. Lunglei East AC MLA, Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng who is also the incumbent Vice Chairman, Lunglei High Powered Committee, graced the occasion as Chief Guest. With a medal tally of 23 (Gold â€“ 7, Silver â€“ 7, Bronze - 9) under various sports disciplines, Lunglei East Assembly Constituency ranked 11 th out of the 40 Assembly Constituencies in Mizoram, and were placed first among the Constituencies under Lunglei District. Congratulating the athletes and the Organizing Committee on their remarkable feat, the Lunglei East AC MLA, Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng praised the team for the grit and determination that they exhibited during the highly competitive Mizoram State Games 2019. He encouraged the young winners to work hard, dream big and set their sights on bigger platforms, even international ones, which, he pointed, out was well within their reach if they played their cards right. He also exhorted upon them to educate themselves on various schemes and benefits available to sportspersons under the state and central governments. en: Floral tributes paid to Mahatma Gandhi in Mizoram No.244/2020-2021 Aizawl the 2nd October, 2020: Floral tributes were paid at the statue of Mahatma Gandhi early this morning at MG Road, Aizawl by the Hon'ble Governor, Chief Minister Deputy Chief Minister and other leaders of the state on the 151st birth anniversary of the Father of the Nation. Governor P.S. Sreedharan Pillai, Chief Minister Zoramthanga, Deputy Chief Minister Tawnluia offered floral wreath on the occasion. Legislative Assembly Speaker and Dy Speaker, Ministers and MLAs, AMC Mayor and important officials also placed floral offering. Celebrated yearly across the country on October 2nd, Gandhi Jayanti is one of the official declared national holidays of India, observed in all of its states and territories. en: CHIEF MINISTER ATTENDED GRADUATION AND LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY AT RIPANS Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga attended the Lamp Lighting & Graduation Ceremony at Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS), Aizawl as chief guest yesterday. Speaking on the occassion, the Chief Minister offered his congratulations to the graduates, wishing them success in their future careers. He also encouraged the new B.Sc Nursing students to be diligent in their studies to become exceptional healthcare professionals, which is one of the most noble profession. Speaking of how the government takes various measures to ensure examplary healthcare system, the Chief Minister said that public support is needed for success. In yesterday's function the Chief Minister gave away Proficiency Award to toppers of all departments in the institute. This year saw 180 graduates from RIPANS with 36 B.Sc. Nursing, 40 B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 23 B. Pharm, 34 B. Optometry, 31 B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) and 16 M. Pharm. Dr. Chawngthanliana, Director, RIPANS handed out Certificate of Appreciation to the new Graduates and Post Graduates. 35 students of B.Sc Nuring were newly inducted through the Lamp Lighting Ceremony with Pi Lalrinthangi, Nursing Superintendent, Civil Hospital Aizawl as lamp lighter. RIPANS was set up by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 1995-96 under North Eastern Council (NEC). Then it was transferred to the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on April, 2007. As of 2019, 2820 students have graduated from RIPANS since it's inception in 1996. Presently, there are 655 students enrolled in the six departments the institution offers. With the recommendation of the Meeting of Executive Council of the Institute under the Ministry earlier this year which approved Rs. 480.12 cr. for Upgradation and Development of RIPANS, plans to open seven more departments. Apart from this, creation of 154 posts including that of medical doctors, nurses and other paramedics, and infrastructural developments including hospitals, academic building, sports complex, hostel and quarters are underway. mz: CHIEF MINISTER IN RIPANS AH GRADUATION LEH LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY A HMANPUI Vawiin khan Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga chuan Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS) ah kumina Nursing leh Paramedical Course hrang hranga zirlai pass thar te graduation lawmna leh Bachelor of Nursing zirlai thar 35-te lawmluhna Lamp Lighting Ceremony chu khuallian niin a hmanpui a. Zirlai titha zual te hnenah Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Chief Minister chuan graduate tharte chu a lawmpui thu a sawi a. Mahni mihring puite tan an thiamna hmang a, enkawl dam hna thawh chu hna ropui tak a nih thu sawiin, zirlai pass tharte chu an kal zelna turah pawh taima leh rinawm taka an thawh zui a, hlawhtlinna an chan chhoh zel turin a duhsakna a hlan. Chief Minister chuan Mizoramah mihring hriselna tihhmasawn a inenkawlna tha zawk neih chu sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh thu a sawi a. Chumi atan chuan sawrkar chauhin thil a tih theihloh thu leh, hriselna kawnga ramin hma a sawn tak tak dawn chuan mipui tawiawmna a mamawh thu a sawi. Chief Minister chuan RIPANS pawh changtlung zawka siam tura hmalakna awm mek chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, thawktu indaihlohna avanga harsatna an tawh chungchangah theih tawp chhuahpui a tum thu a sawi a ni. Chief Minister chuan graduate thar te zingah an department theuh a titha zualte hnenah RIPANS Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Vawiin hunah hian RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana leh Lamp Lighter Civil Hospital Nursing Superintendent Pi Lalrinthangi ten thu an sawi bawk. BSc Nursing First year hi an vawiin mi 35 an ni a. RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana chuan Graduate leh Post Graduate tharte hnenah Certificate of Appreciation a hlan a ni. Kumin hian a vaiin mi 180 zirchhuak an awm a. Chungte chu: i) B.Sc. Nursing - 36 ii) B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology) - 40 iii) B. Pharm - 23 iv) B. Optometry - 34 v) B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) - 31 vi) M. Pharm - 16 RIPANS hi kum 1996 khan North Eastern Council (NEC) in India hmarchhak mite tan Paramedical leh Health Sciences bik zirna atana din in, kum 2007 April thla atangin sawrkar laipuia Ministry of Health and Family Welfare hnuaiah dah a ni ta a. Tun dinhmunah Degree Course hrang hrang panga - B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Medical laboratory Technology, B. Pharm, B. Optometry leh B.Sc Radio Imaging Technology bakah October 2014 atang khan Post Graduate Course M. Pharm te awmin, India hmarchhak state hrang hrang atangin zirlaite tan seat hauhsa (quota) neiih zirlai 655 an awm mek a ni. Kum 1996 atanga kumin 2019 thleng hian RIPANS atanga zirchhuak mi 2820 an awm tawh a ni. Ministry of Health & Family Welfare hnuaia Executive Council meeting kumin kumtir a neihin RIPANS tihchangtlun na turin Rs. 480.12 crores pek a remti a. He hmalakna hnuaiah hian khum 100 awm theihna hospital, Academic building, Indoor Sports Complex cum Auditorium, P.G. Hostel, Guest House, Medical Superintendent Quarter, Doctor Quarter, Nurses/ Staff quarter sakna tur te, thawktu post 154 siam belhna tur leh Course thar pasarih hawnna tur te a tel a ni. en: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. en: NABARD CELEBRATES INTERNATIONAL WOMENâ€™S DAY 2024 - EXHIBITION STALLS INAUGURATED TO MARK THE OCCASION 373/2023-2024 Aizawl the 8th March, 2024 : Under the aegis of NABARD, Mizoram Regional Office, Aizawl, International Womenâ€™s Day 2024 Celebration Programme was held at HYVE City Hall, Aizawl on 08 March 2024 at 11:30 AM with the Theme â€˜Count Her In: Accelerating gender Equality through Economic Empowermentâ€™. The Function was graced by Pi H Lalchhandami, CEO, MzSRLM, Pi Lalrohlupuii, SMS, Home Science KVK, Aizawl, Pi Lalhlupuii Ralte, Proprietor, Zo Bio Hub, Pu KVSSLV Prasada Rao, General Manager/ OIC, NABARD, Mizoram, T Khup Guite, Deputy General Manager, NABARD. Women SHG Members, successful Women Entreprepeurs participated in the celebration. Pu KVSSLV Prasada Rao, General Manager/ OIC, NABARD welcomed the guests and delivered a key note address highlighting the purpose of organising IWD 2024 function. He highlighted Women are at the centre of various developmental and promotional interventions supported by NABARD such as Skill Development, Tribal Development, Micro Enterprise Development for SHGs in the State of Mizoram. He also highlighted the role played by women in the societal and economic development of the State. Pi Lalhpuluii Ralte, Proprietor, Zo Bio Hub who is a successful woman entrepreneur shared her experience of managing a start-up firm benefitting farmers with market linkages. Zo Bio Hub is a startup that aims to preserve the biodiversity and encourages farmers to grow native aromatic and medicinal plants. Pi Lalrohlupuii who is an expert in Home Science in KVK-Aizawl spoke on the role of KVKs in the country in general and the state of Mizoram in particular. She informed that KVK impart training and technological knowledge to the farmers and rural youth in the state. She stressed for the need of proper nutritional diet, negative effect of having excess sugar and salt in human body, feeding children with proper nutrition and the role of Women SHGs in women empowerment. Pi H Lalchhandami, CEO, MzSRLM graced the function as Chief Guest delivered a talk on the role of Rural Livelihood Mission in the State for womenâ€™s economic empowerment. She thanked NABARD for the support and collaboration extended to MzSRLM in this endeavour. She highlighted the role played by Women SHGs, SHGs federations or Village Organisations (VOs) for their women members. For taking up enterprise activities by women members of SHGs, Community Investment Fund (CIF) and Credit Linkages Banks played a great role in the process. en: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT CONSULTATIVE COMMITTEE (DCC) & DISTRICT LEVEL REVIEW COMMITTEE (DLRC) No.517/2020-2021 Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC) & District Level Review Committee (DLRC) under the Chairmanship of Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, Deputy Commissioner Champhai held meeting today at DCâ€™s Conference Hall, the Chairman launched the Potential Credit Linked Plan (PLP) 2021-2022 for Champhai District. Chairman urged the Bankers to conduct massive and wider public awareness campaign on facilities provided through Banks. Also the Deputy Commissioner reiterated the urgency of making application forms more simplified instead of intricated forms to facilitate ease of doing business. Pu L.Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office delivered welcome speech followed by discussion on the performances of Bankers and Stakeholders for the quarter ended September, 2020. According to the reporting period, Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio was 44.71 %, against the norm of 60%. Achievement under Priority Sector was 38.42 % while it was 73.43% under Non Priority Sector. Under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) there were 34 beneficiaries (Sishu-20, Kishore-98, Tarun-12, Stand Up India-4) getting loan amounting rupess 200.49 lakhs. Target achievement under Government Sponsored Schemes were also discussed at length. Forty two Bakijai Cases amounting rupees 21.61 lakhs have been reported, and no recovery is reported during the quarter. Non Performing Asset (NPA) under Priority Sector was rupees 1217.20 lakhs (7.07%) while the same in Non Priority Sector was rupees 86.40 lakhs (2.25%). Annual Credit Plan Target for Financial Year 2021-2022 and PMEGP Annual Credit Plan Target were also discussed and approved at the meeting. Also Social Security Schemes, Currency remittance, Bank security, Calendar for DCC meeting and timely submission of DCC data were also discussed among other issues. As of now, there are 15 different Banks branches operating in the district; 4 Public Sector Banks, 4 Private Sector Banks, 6 Regional Rural Banks and 1 State Cooperative Bank. There are a total of 9 ATMs, 8 Business Correspondents, 1 CSP, 26 IPPB Banking Touch Points and 2 Financial Literacy Centres (Lead Bank Office, SBI Sponsored and Champhai Financial Literacy Centre, MCAB Ltd.) in the district. en: Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman calls on Chief Minister No.252/2021-2022 Aizawl the 18th August, 2021: Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga, Chairman of State Planning Board was called on by State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC), Meghalaya today at the formerâ€™s office where they discussed important issues relating to economic development for both states. The Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman expressed his gratitude for the outstanding hospitality shown by Mizoram and hoped that the bond between the two states would continue to flourish. Speaking of how he works closely with Mizo community and many sub-tribes of Mizoram in his constituency, he expressed his optimism for an enduring friendship and partnership in all sectors. Mizoram Chief Minister echoed the importance of nurturing good relations between the two states, and said that should any situation arise where Mizoram can assist Meghalaya in the development of its economy, Mizoram shall do its best. After his meeting with the Chief Minister, Pu Lambor Malngiang met with Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi followed by a meeting with NGO leaders of the state. He was accompanied by Dr. Krishna Chauhan, Expert Member (Economist) Meghalaya State Planning Board and Pu Enrich GL Nongbri, Law Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. mz: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. en: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak Contact Number is given as 8588009756/9436376607.
mz: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK THUKHAWM Tunlaia China leh khawvel ram dangte ngaihven hlawh tak Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) natna leng mek laka Champhai District lo him leh invenlawkna tura din, District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak chu a vawikhatna turin vawiin chawhnu khan Bawrhsap Pu SL Naveen, IAS hovin DC Conference Hall-ah an thukhawm. Meeting-ah hian Champhai District chu International Border-a awm anih avangin Novel Coronavirus leng darh zel tur laka fimkhur angaih thu tarlan niin, meeting chuan ramri kaltlanga veivak leh sumdawng thinte chu he natna len mekna hmun leh a chhehvelte laka fimkhur turin a ngen a. He hunah hian mihring veivak leh ran khuahkhirh anih dante ngaihthlak a ni bawk a. Champhai District ep Myanmar ram District-te nena inbiakpawh leh inzaitawn zela hmalak a tul thu pawh tarlan a ni a. District Task Force on Coronavirus Outbreak chuan ramri depa awm khuate chu tlawhchhuaka mipuite hnena zirtirna zau zawk kalpui nise, ramri kaltlanga lutte hriselna endik pahin chhui zui ngai awmte pawh chhuichian ni se a ti a. Champhai District Hospital-a Isolation Ward ruahman ni se tih bakah mamawh tur ang budget-te pawh a rang lama siama thuneitu sang zawk hnena thlen nise tih a ni. District Level Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak hi Mizoram State Health Minister leh H&FW Department hotute January Ni 30, 2020 a thukhawm in an din tak State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus duh dan anga district tina hma lo la tur a din a ni. Champhai District-a Zokhawtharah February Ni 4, 2020 atang khan Medical Screening hi kalpui tan a ni a, khualzinte chinchang zawhfiah leh a tul anga endik hna hi kalpui thin niin, Self Reporting Form mumal tak kalpui tan a ni tawh bawk. Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak chuan mamawhtute tana biak pawhna tur Mobile No-8588009756/9436376607 a siam bawk a ni. Attachment Loading attachment...

en:
As we have listened, there was a Government of India notification on September 
24, 2020, and based on that, all the states followed. But ‘water’ falls under the state list, 
so the state government has the authority. 16 states and 5 UTs currently have a similar
act regarding this, and 11 states are currently discussing this Act. Four states regarded 
it as unnecessary to have this Act, these are Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Sikkim, and 
Tripura. On the other hand, I believe Mizoram urgently requires this Act, but there must 
be a way to control it. Whoever is capable of doing it must not attempt to pump out 
water, as it could disturb the water tables. So, it is good that such acts as these exist. 
Chapter 6, Section 29 (C), talks about penalties for violators.
mz:
Kan ngaihthlak ang khan, September Ni 24, 2020-ah Govt. of India notification 
a awm a, chu mi dungzuiin State tinah buatsaih a ni bawk a. Amaherawhchu, tui hi State 
List a nih angin state tin sorkar chu a thu viau mai a. Tunah hian State 16 leh UT 5-ah 
he Dan hi neih a ni tawh a. Tin, State 11-ah ngaihtuah mek a ni bawk a. State 4 hi chuan 
an ramah he Dan neih hi tul an ti lova, chungte chu - Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, 
Sikkim leh Tripura te an ni. Mizoram-ah erawh chuan a tul ngawih ngawihin ka hria a. 
Amaherawhchu, control a ngai a ni. Tute’n emaw an duh duhna hmunah an pump 
chhuak rikngawt kha chu a him lova, lei hnuaia water table te pawh tibuai thei a ni. 
Chuvangin, hetianga Dan lo awm hi a tha ka ti a. Chapter 6, section 29(C)-ah khan 
hremna Dan a awm a.

en: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS OBSERVES TODAY Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) was observed today at AR Ground, Aizawl. Deputy Chief Minister Shri Tawnluia graced the event as Chief Guest. Chief Secretary Shri Lalnunmawia Chuaungo administered the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas Pledge taking ceremony. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) celebration started early in the morning with a â€˜Unity Runâ€™ from Sikulpuikawn and Chanmari, flagged off by the Commissioner and Secretaries of School Education and Higher & Technical Departments respectively. About 500 students participated in this run to permeate national unity. Nine Contingents participated in the March Past, Assam Riffles Band Party performed the National Anthem. mz: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS ROPUI TAKA HMAN A NI Vawiin zing khan AR Ground-ah Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) hman a ni a, Deputy Chief Minister Pu Tawnluia chu khuallian a ni. Khuallian Pu Tawnluia chuan thu sawiin, India hnam inpumkhatna atana hma nasa taka la tu Sardar Valabhai Patel piancham denchhenin October Ni 31 chu Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (Hnam Inpumkhatna Ni)-ah India sawrkar chuan a puang a ni, a ti a. Deputy Chief Minister chuan Kum 2014 atangin Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) hman tan a ni a, vawiin hi vawi ruk hmanna a ni, tiin a sawi a. Kum 1917-ah Sardar Valabhai Patel chuan India Hnam Pa Mahatma Gandhi thusawi a ngaihthlak a tangin India hnam tan theih tawp a chhuah a, huaisen taka thawk mi, â€˜Iron Man of Indiaâ€™ ti hiala koh thin a ni, a ti a. British in India a chhuahsan dawn khan India lal ram hrang hrang 500 chuang India chunga an awm khawm theih nan hma a la a ni a ti a. Khuallian Pu Tawnluia chuan India zalenna sual chhuaktute zinga mi pawimawh Sardar Valabhai Patel ang hian hnam tana thawk turin leh inpumkhatna vawng nung zel turin kalkhawmte a sawm a ni. Chief Secretary Pu Lalnunmawia Chuaungo chuan hemi hun hmang tura kal zawng zawng hnenah Rashtriya Ekta Diwas thutiam a chham tir a. Contingent 9- Assam Riffles, BSF, 1st Battalion MAP, 3rd Battalion MAP, 5th IR Battalion, Home Guard, 225 Battalion CRPF, One Mizo Air Squadron NCC, 20 Mizo Independent Company NCC te parade in, Parade Commander hi Inspector PC Vanlalsawma, MAP a ni a, Assam Riffles Band Party ten National Anthem an tum bawk a ni. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas lawmna a tan hian zing Dar 7-ah sikul naupang 500 ten Sikulpuikawn leh Chanmari atangin Run for Unity neiin, AR Ground-ah an in tawk khawm a ni. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 67/2023-2024 PUBLIC ADVISORY ON DIGITAL PAYMENT FRAUD With the increasing use of Digital Payment Systems, Mizoram has also witnessed a sharp increase in digital payment frauds. Cyber fraudsters are finding new methods to dupe vulnerable and unsuspecting citizens. Online financial frauds account for more than 75% of all cyber-crimes reported in the State. With an aim to prevent financial losses to the general public through online frauds, Mizoram Police once again appeals to public to take following precautions: 1. Never share your Banking password, OTP (one time password) or Debit/Credit Card details with others. 2. Never scan QR Code, when you are to receive money. It is only required for transferring money to other accounts. 3. Beware of phishing scams trying to steal your Banking or UPI information. Look out for fake emails and websites, that try to collect information and do not click on unknownâ€™unfamiliar links. 4. Always use familiar websites for online shopping rather than shopping by searching products on search engines. Search results can be misleading and may lead to malicious websites. 5. Ignore advertisements/deals, if they claim that you can earn money with little or no work or you can make money on an investment with little or no risk. If an offer seems too good to be true, it is most likely to be a scam. 6. Beware of fake loan apps that provide quick and easy loans. Such illegal apps will seek a variety of information and permissions from applicants, which is then misused to blackmail them later. If using digital loan app, please ensure that it has RBI authorization. 7. Beware of fraudsters, who impersonate as army/police personnel advertising cheap items online. We urge citizens to exercise extreme caution, while conducting financial transactions online. If you are a victim of financial fraud, call Cyber Helpline 1930 or register your complaints on www.cybercrime.gov.in . STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT AT www.cybercrime.gov.in : 1. Go to the website â€œ www.cybercrime.gov.inâ€ through any mobile or computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) 2. There will be two red boxes. Select the box titled â€˜File a complaintâ€. 3. Click on the 7 Acceptâ€™ box that comes up. 4. Click on â€˜Report Cyber Crimeâ€™. 5. On the new page that comes up, first click on â€˜Click here for new userâ€™ on the top right and fill up the form. 6. After logging into your account, register your complaint. Select the cybercrime category that pertains to you. 7. If you were duped of money through an online transaction, select â€˜Online Financial Fraudâ€™ 8. Enter details of the bank account from which money was sent. 9. If payment was done through UPI, select the UPI app (BHIM, GPay, Paytm, etc) which you used to send money. 10. Enter the transaction ID of where you sent the money. Note: Transaction IDs are of 12 digits. They can be obtained from your bank statement or your UPI transaction details received through SMS. 11. If your account had been credited without your knowledge, enter the relevant details on â€˜Credit Transaction detailsâ€™. 12. After having entered all details as required, select â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 13. On the next page, enter details of the fraudster if you are aware. Then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 14. On the next page, enter the complainant/victimâ€™s details and then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 15. Lastly, click on â€˜I Agreeâ€™ and then â€˜Confirm and Submitâ€™. After this has been completed, you will receive an SMS with an acknowledgement number through which you will be able to keep track of your case.
mz: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 566/2023-2024 Mizoram police media cell chuan Digital Payment System chungchanga mipuite hnena thurawn a hnuaia mi ang hian a ti chhuak : DIGITAL PAYMENT INBUMNA CHUNGCHANGA THURAWN : Digital Payment Systems hman kan uar chhoh viau laiin hemi kaihhnawiha inbumna pawh nasa takin Mizoramah ngei pawh a sang chho chak hie a ni. Hetianga internet khawvela bum tur zawng ho hian rinhlelh nachang hre lo leh bum awlsam tur zawngin, inbum dan thar an hmu chhuak reng bawk. Tunah hian Mizorama Cyber Crime case ziah luh zinga 75% aia tarn hi 'online financial fraud' kaihhnawih a ni. Chuvangin hetianga inbumna laka kan himna atan Mizoram Poice chuan a hnuaia tarlan ang hian mipuite a ngen a ni: I banking password, OTP, Debit Card/Credit Card details te tumah hrilh suh. Pawisa dawngtu tur i nihin eng QR Code mah scan suh. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu tur tan lo chuan engmah scan a ngai lo. Phishing scammer te hian i Bank leh UPI information pawimawh ruksak che an turn reng tih hria la, email leh website lemah te, link hriat chian lohah te lut mai mai suh ang che. Online-a thil i lei dawnin Search Engine atanga product zawn hi a him tawk lo thin a, chuvangin online shopping website hriat chian saah ngei thil enin lei thin ang che. Engmah thawk mang lova pawisa hlawh theihna te, pawisa dah punna hlawk lutuk leh him si tih ang chi, thil tha uchuak lutuk ang hi inbumna a ni tlangpui tih hria ang che. Awlsam leh rang taka Loan pe chhuak thei anga insawi application leh website lakah fimkhur ang che. Loan pe turin mimal thil pawimawh tinreng an dil a, heng te hi a hnua blackmail lehna atan te an hmang thin a ni. Loan App i hmang a nih pawhin RBI phalna nei an ni ngei em tih chian ang che. Police/Army anga insawi a, thil tlawm tak taka tiral duh anga online-a inzuar thinte hi misual an ni tlangpui tih hre bawk ang che. Online a sum chet velna tur thil khawih reng rengin theihtawpa fimkhur turin mipuite kan chah nawn leh a, hetianga bumna tuartu i nih chuan Cyber Helpline 1930-ah emaw, www.cybercrime.gov.in ah emaw complaint i thehlut thei a ni. A HNUAIA TARLAN ANG HI www.cybercrime.gov.in AH COMPLAINT THEHLUH DAN A NI. 1. Mobile leh Computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) eng atang pawhin www.cybercrime.gov.in i lut ang. 2. Box sen pahnih a lo awm ang a, "File Complaint' tih zawkah i lut ang. 3. "I Accept" tih a lo lang ang a, i lo click ang. 4. "Report Cyber Crime" tih i hmu ang a, i click ang. 5. Page thar a lo inhawng ang a, "Click here for new user" tihah lutin, form i fill-up ang. 6. Account i logged-in hnuah cyber crime category thlanna a lo awm ang a, i report duh category i thlang ang. 7. Online transaction hmanga bum i nih chuan "Online Financial Fraud" i thlang ang. 8. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu bank account details i chhu lut ang. 9. UPI hmanga pawisa thawn a nih chuan i UPI App hman (BHIM, Gpay, Paytm, etc.) i thlang ang. 10. I pawisa thawn chhuahna Transaction ID i chhu lut ang. Hriattur: Transaction ID hi digit 12 a ni a, pawisa i thawn a bank atanga SMS i dawn thin angah khan a awm. 11. I account-ah i hriatlohvin pawisa a lo lut a nih chuan "Credit Transaction Details" tihah khan a tul angin i fill up bawk dawn nia. 12. Hetianga a ml i tih zawh hnu hian "Save as Draft and Next" tih i thlang ang. 13. A phek dawt lehah a misual/bumtu i hriat chuan a details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 14. A phek dawt lehah a tuartu/a complaint tu details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 15. "I Agree" i thlang ang a, chumi hnuah "Confirm and Submit" i thlang leh dawn nia. Hetianga i tih zawh hnu hian SMS in acknowledgement number i dawng ang a, chumi hmang chuan i case chinchang i enzui duh hunah i enzui thei ang.
